card.description: Tidy the conversation list by archiving conversations nobody has touched for a while.
card.title: Archive

description: Archives a conversation once it has had no activity for the chosen time. Pinned, running, handed-off and IM conversations are never auto-archived, nor the one you have open. Archived conversations can be restored at any time.
hostDecides: Your Host owns these conversations, so it decides when they are archived. Change this on the Host.
label: Auto-archive

options.days: {count, plural, one {After # day of inactivity} other {After # days of inactivity}}
